title: potamogeton natans f. terrestris
intro: Potamogeton natans f. terrestris, commonly known as terrestrial frogbit, is a subspecies of aquatic plant belonging to the family Potamogetonaceae. The terrestrial frogbit is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Potamogeton natans f. terrestris include wound healing, reducing fever, and relieving respiratory issues. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
